paletteHint: Type a word from a board name, card title, description or comment.
paletteNoResults: Nothing matches "{query}". Try a shorter or different word.
paletteCardUnassigned: You are no longer assigned to "{title}"
paletteCardActionsHint: shows the actions of the highlighted card
paletteNewCardHint: Enter adds the card to {column} and opens it. Esc goes back.
authCodeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
authOr: or
authNeedAccount: Need an account? Ask your administrator.
authCodeInvalid: That code is not valid. Check your authenticator app and try again.
authSsoNotLinked: This single sign-on account is not linked to a Kanbun user. Sign in with your password and link it in Settings, or ask your administrator.
authSsoSignupDisabled: There is no Kanbun account for this single sign-on user, and new accounts can not be created this way. Ask your administrator to create one.
authSsoDeactivated: This account has been deactivated. Ask your administrator.
authSsoIdentityInUse: This single sign-on account is already linked to another Kanbun user.
authSsoAlreadyLinked: Your account is already linked to a different single sign-on account. Disconnect it first.
authSsoInvalidProfile: The identity provider did not send a usable profile. Ask your administrator.
authSsoFailed: Single sign-on failed. Try again or ask your administrator.
listEmpty: No cards yet. Add the first one in the board view.
savedFilterDeleteBody: It is removed for everyone on this board. Cards are not affected.
notifSubtaskAssignedGeneric: {actor} assigned you a checklist item on {card}
cardNoComments: No comments yet. Write the first one below; type @ to mention a teammate.
activityBlocked: {actor} marked this card as blocked by {title}
mentionSuggestionsCount: {count} people to mention. Use the up and down arrows to choose and Enter to insert.
attachmentsHint: Drop files here or use Add files. Up to {max} each.
attachmentDeleteBody: {name} is removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.
activitySubtaskConverted: {actor} turned the subtask {title} into a card
subtaskDndInstructions: To reorder a subtask, press Space on its handle, move it with the arrow keys, then press Space again to drop it or Escape to cancel.
myTasksEmpty: Cards assigned to you on any board show up here, grouped by deadline. Open a card and add yourself, or press a on a focused card.
homeCategoryEmpty: No boards here yet. Drag one in or add a new board.
homeCategoryAllPinned: The boards of this category are pinned and shown under Pinned.
homeEmpty: Boards hold your columns and cards. Start from a template like Simple or Software, or a blank board.
confirmDeleteTagBody: It will be removed from every card on this board.
confirmRemoveMemberBody: They will lose access to the board. Cards assigned to them keep the assignment.
confirmDeleteUserBody: The account is removed for good. Cards and comments they wrote stay and show "Deleted user". To keep their name on their work, deactivate the account instead.
confirmDeactivateUserBody: They are signed out right away and can no longer log in. Their cards, comments and history stay. You can reactivate the account later.
passwordResetToast: Password changed. They are signed out everywhere.
trashIntro: Deleted cards, columns and boards stay here for {days} days, then they are removed for good.
trashEmpty: Anything you delete stays here for {days} days, so you can restore it.
error_unauthorized: Your session has ended. Log in again.
error_forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
error_notFound: That no longer exists. Refresh the page.
error_invalid: Some of the input isn't valid. Check it and try again.
error_selfAction: You can't do that to your own account.
error_userNotFound: There is no active user with that username.
error_crossBoard: Both cards must be on the same board.
error_noColumns: Add a column to the board first, then restore the card.
error_restoreBoardFirst: Its board was deleted. Restore the board first.
error_invalidCode: That code or password is not right. Try again.
error_tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
error_lastSignInMethod: This is your only way to sign in, so it can not be removed.
errorBody: This page couldn't be loaded. Try again, or go back to your boards.
notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
ownRoleLocked: You can't change your own role.
dndInstructions: To pick up a card or column, press Space. Move it with the arrow keys, press Space to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
dndCancelled: Move cancelled. {title} is back where it was.
cardAddHint: Enter to add. Paste several lines to add several cards.
shortcutPaletteCard: In search: actions for the highlighted card
shortcutNew: Add a card to the focused column
shortcutAssign: Assign the focused card to me
shortcutClose: Close the card panel or a menu
shortcutLift: Pick up or drop the focused card
presenceCardTwo: {a} and {b} are also viewing this card
presenceCardMany: {name} and {count} others are also viewing this card
settingsNotificationsHint: Choose how you hear about each kind of activity. Email always includes the in-app notification. Watch a card or board to follow it; you watch cards you create, comment on or are assigned to automatically.
settingsEmailDisabled: Email is not set up on this server, so the email options are turned off. An administrator can enable it by setting SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM.
settingsEmailHint: Used only for notification emails and the daily digest. Leave empty for no email.
settingsNotifTableCaption: How you are notified, per type
settingsDigestHint: Once a day, a summary of new notifications you have not read yet.
ssoSectionHint: Link your {provider} account to sign in with single sign-on.
ssoUnlinkConfirmBody: You will sign in with your password only. You can connect the account again later.
ssoOnlyNotice: You sign in with {provider} only, so it can not be disconnected.
ssoErrorIdentityInUse: That {provider} account is already connected to another Kanbun user.
ssoErrorAlreadyLinked: You already have a different {provider} account connected. Disconnect it first.
ssoErrorGeneric: Connecting {provider} did not work. Try again or ask your administrator.
twoFactorHint: After your password, sign-in also asks for a code from an authenticator app on your phone.
twoFactorScan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or 1Password), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactorQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactorManual: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
twoFactorRecoveryHint: Each code works once, in place of an app code, if you lose your phone. Save them somewhere safe now: they are not shown again.
twoFactorCredential: Current code, recovery code or password
twoFactorManage: Confirm it's you to turn two-factor off or to replace your recovery codes (the old ones stop working).
twoFactorSsoOnly: You sign in with single sign-on, so your identity provider handles two-factor authentication.
adminReset2faBody: They can then sign in with only their password and set it up again in Settings. Do this only after checking it is really them.
audit_2fa_reset: Two-factor authentication reset by an admin
audit_recoveryCode_used: Recovery code used to sign in
watchCardHint: Get notified about comments, moves and the deadline of this card
watchBoardHint: Get notified about new cards on this board
activityCreatedFromTemplate: {actor} created this card in {column} from the template {template}
activityCreatedBySchedule: Created in {column} by the repeating schedule for {template}, set up by {actor}
templatesIntro: Reusable cards with a title, description, priority, tags and checklist. Use them from a column's add card button.
templatesEmpty: No templates yet. Create one below, or save an existing card as a template from its menu.
confirmDeleteTemplateBody: Cards made from it stay. Repeating schedules that use it are paused.
repeatIntro: Create a card from a template on a schedule, for chores like weekly reviews or monthly invoices. Times use the server's clock.
repeatNeedsTemplate: Create a card template first, then schedule it here.
repeatMonthEndHint: In shorter months it runs on the last day.
repeatBroken: Its template or column was deleted, so it no longer runs.
boardEmptyTitle: This board has no cards yet
boardEmptyBody: Press n to add a card, or use Add card at the bottom of a column. Drag cards to the next column as work moves along.
boardEmptyNoColumns: Start with a column for each stage of your work, like To do, Doing and Done.
boardTplSimpleDesc: Three columns for any kind of work.
boardTplSoftwareDesc: A development flow with review, plus Bug, Feature and Chore tags.
boardTplPersonalDesc: Plan your week and focus on today.
boardTplBlankDesc: No columns. Build your own flow.
setupIntro: This is a new Kanbun install. The first account manages users and settings; you can invite your team afterwards.
setupUsernameHint: 2 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
setupUsernameInvalid: Use 2 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores for the username.
setupBoardIntro: Pick a starting point. You can rename, add and remove columns at any time.
settingsApiTokensHint: Personal access tokens let scripts and other tools use the REST API as you, with your permissions.
apiTokenShownOnce: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
confirmRevokeTokenBody: Scripts and tools using it stop working right away. This can not be undone.
webhooksHint: Kanbun sends a signed POST request to these addresses when cards or comments change on this board.
webhookUrlHint: A public http or https address.
webhookTestFailed: The test was not delivered. See the recent deliveries.
webhookFailing_one: {count} failed delivery. It is turned off after {limit} in a row.
webhookFailing_other: {count} failed deliveries in a row. It is turned off after {limit}.
confirmDeleteWebhookBody: Kanbun stops sending events to {url}. Its delivery history is removed.
error_limitReached: You have reached the limit. Remove one first.
error_webhookUrl: Use a public http or https address.
backupBody: Downloads a consistent copy of the database and every attachment as one .tar.gz file. Kanbun keeps running while it is made.
backupRestoreHint: To restore, stop Kanbun, replace kanbun.db and the attachments folder in the data volume with the ones from the archive, and start it again. The README has the exact steps.
backupUnsupported: One-click backup is only available with the built-in SQLite database. This instance uses another database: back it up with that database's own tools (for PostgreSQL, pg_dump) and copy the attachments folder.
exportAllBody: Every board (archived ones too), with columns, cards, checklists, comments and tags, plus users and categories, as one JSON file in the Kanbun export format. No passwords or attachment files.
importAdminBody: Create boards from a Trello export or a Kanbun JSON export. CSV files are imported into an existing board from its settings.
importIntro: Upload a Trello board export or a board exported from Kanbun. It becomes a new board that you own.
importHelpTrello: Trello: in Trello open the board menu, then Print, export and share, then Export as JSON. Open lists become columns; archived lists and archived cards are left out. Labels become tags, checklists become the card checklist, and comments are added by you with the original author and date. Card members become assignees when a Kanbun user has the same username.
importHelpKanbun: Kanbun: a JSON file from Export in a board's settings (or the full admin export) is imported as new boards, with members, tags, checklists, comments and templates. Attachment files are not part of exports.
importHelpCsv: CSV: to add cards from a spreadsheet to a board you already have, use Import and export in that board's settings.
importFileHint: Trello or Kanbun JSON, up to {mb} MB.
importSummary: {columns} columns, {cards} cards, {checklistItems} checklist items, {comments} comments, {tags} tags.
importSkipped: Left out because archived in Trello: {lists} lists, {cards} cards.
importUnmatchedUsers: No Kanbun user for: {names}. They were not added.
importError_tooLarge: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
importError_invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON. Choose the .json file from Trello's Export as JSON or from a Kanbun export.
importError_unsupportedVersion: This Kanbun export was made by a newer version. Update Kanbun to import it.
importError_invalidExport: This Kanbun export is incomplete or damaged.
importError_notTrello: This does not look like a Trello board export.
importError_noTitleColumn: Choose which column holds the card title.
importError_tooManyRows: A CSV import can hold at most {max} rows. Split the file.
importError_noValidRows: No row has a card title, so there is nothing to import.
importError_network: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
csvFileHint: Comma, semicolon or tab separated, with a header row, up to {mb} MB.
csvPlanSummary: {cards} cards will be imported. Rows skipped: {skipped}. Warnings: {warnings}.
csvIssueMissingTitle: Line {line}: no title, the row is skipped.
csvIssueBadPriority: Line {line}: unknown priority "{value}", Normal is used.
csvIssueBadDeadline: Line {line}: "{value}" is not a date (use YYYY-MM-DD), no deadline is set.
csvIssueUnknownUser: Line {line}: "{value}" is not a member of this board, not assigned.
csvImportBody: Cards are added at the end of their column. Columns and tags that do not exist yet are created; assignees must be members of this board.
exportBoardBody: JSON keeps everything on the board and can be imported again as a new board. CSV lists the cards for spreadsheets.
offlineBannerNoTime: Offline: showing the last saved data
offlineUnavailable: You are offline. This cannot be saved until you reconnect.
offlineCardUnavailable: Card details are not available offline.
offlineCommentHint: You are offline. Your comment stays here until you can post it.
syncFailed_one: {count} change could not be synced and was discarded: {list}
syncFailed_other: {count} changes could not be synced and were discarded: {list}
pwaUpdateAvailable: A new version of Kanbun is available.
offlinePageBody: This page was not saved for offline use. Boards you opened before are still available.
logoutPendingBody_one: {count} change made offline has not reached the server yet. Logging out discards it.
logoutPendingBody_other: {count} changes made offline have not reached the server yet. Logging out discards them.
networkError: Could not reach the server. Nothing was saved.
